home.next: The dashboard arrives with sales. For now, the owner can manage users, PCs and the audit log in Settings.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.body: Your role does not include this page. The server refuses it too.

hub.title: Settings
hub.subtitle: Owner only. Every change is written to the audit log.
hub.label: Settings

users.title: Users & permissions
users.subtitle: Click a user to see their account and role permissions
users.neverDeleted: Users are never deleted; they are deactivated and stay in documents and the log.
users.ownerNote: The owner account cannot be deactivated or change role, and always uses the 2-step code.
users.deactivated: User deactivated; they can no longer sign in
users.select: Select a user to see their account.

newUser.title: New user
newUser.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dots, e.g. sara.cashier
newUser.note: A temporary code is created and must be changed at first sign-in. Never send passwords by email or chat.
newUser.missing: Fill in both names, the username and the role.
newUser.usernameInvalid: Use 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.

temp.title: Temporary code
temp.note: Shown once only. Hand it to the employee in person; they must change it at first sign-in.
temp.repeat: This code was already shown once and cannot be shown again. Create a new one if it was lost.

deactivate.title: Deactivate user
deactivate.note: They can no longer sign in; their name stays in documents and the log. You can reactivate them.

roles.approvable: A supervisor can approve it once
roles.ownerLocked: The owner role always has every permission.
roles.discountInvalid: Enter a percent from 0 to 100 and an amount in AED with up to 2 decimals.
roles.serverChecks: The server checks permissions on every action; hiding buttons is not enough.
roles.saved: Permissions saved; they apply to everyone in the role at once
roles.unsavedSwitch: You have unsaved permission changes; save or cancel them first

newRole.title: New role
newRole.created: Role created. Assign it from a user’s card.

devices.title: Devices & printers
devices.subtitle: Only enrolled devices can connect to the server
devices.neverAgain: A revoked device can never connect again, and stays in the log.
devices.enrollHelp: Install the app on the new device, then enter this code on it with the server address.
devices.codeExpired: The code expired. Create a new one.
devices.openCode: A code is open until {time}. It was shown once; create a new one if it was lost.
devices.codeCreated: New code created; any earlier code no longer works
devices.revokeNote: This cannot be undone: a revoked device can only connect again after a new enrollment.
devices.revoked_toast: {code} revoked. It can no longer reach the server.
devices.name: PC name
devices.trustedUntil: No phone code here for {name} until {date}
devices.endTrustBody: The code from the phone will be asked again on {device} for: {names}.
devices.trustEnded: Trust ended: the phone code is needed again on this PC
devices.warehouseNote: The warehouse each PC sells and issues stock from. “Default warehouse” follows the default warehouse in Lists.
devices.receiptPrinterHelp: The POS prints receipts to this printer without a print dialog, and opens the cash drawer connected to it. The choice is kept on this PC only.
devices.printerWindowsOnly: Printers can be chosen in the Windows app only.
devices.printerListFailed: The list of printers could not be read.
devices.printerSaved: Receipt printer saved for this PC
devices.testSent: Test receipt sent to the printer
devices.printerA4: A4 invoices print through the Windows print dialog, to any printer.
devices.testReceiptBody: If you can read this text clearly, the printer works.

printerProblem.browser: Printing works in the Windows app only.
printerProblem.failed: The printer did not respond. Check that it is on, connected and has paper.
printerProblem.no_drawer: The cash drawer opens only with a thermal receipt printer (ESC/POS).

devices.moveDrawerTitle: Move the drawer to another PC
devices.moveDrawerNote: Drawer {drawer} of the revoked PC “{code}” moves with its history, and its open shift if any, to the POS PC you choose. Use it when the same PC was enrolled again.
devices.noPosTarget: There is no active point-of-sale PC to move it to.

printerModeHelp.escpos: For 80 mm or 58 mm receipt printers such as Epson TM-T20III. Fast, cuts the paper and opens the cash drawer wired to the printer. If the test prints blank or rubbish pages, choose “Any printer”.
printerModeHelp.driver: For an A4 printer, or a receipt printer whose Windows driver does not take ESC/POS. The receipt prints at its real width through the printer’s driver. The cash drawer does not open this way.

devices.trustedUntilPasswordChange: No phone code here for {name} until their password changes

screenLock.title: Screen lock
screenLock.help: The screen locks after a time without use, and the person signs in again. Choose per kind of PC.
screenLock.note: Without a lock, anyone who finds a PC open works under its owner's name. The session still ends after its maximum length. Changes apply to new sign-ins.
screenLock.invalid: Enter a number of minutes from 1 to 240.

kiosk.turnOnTitle: Turn the kiosk lock back on
kiosk.turnOffNote: Only the screen lock is lifted: the app can be minimised or closed on that PC. PIN sign-in, shifts and permissions stay the same. The PC shows “Kiosk lock is off”.
kiosk.turnOnNote: The app goes back to full screen on that PC and cannot be closed.
kiosk.untilOn: Until I turn it back on
kiosk.codeMissing: Type the 6 digits of your 2-step code.
kiosk.turnedOn: Kiosk lock of {code} is on again.
kiosk.alertsHelp: Kiosk lock changes and attempts to leave the POS app, last 30 days.

alert.offFor: Kiosk lock turned off for {minutes} minutes
alert.offUntilOn: Kiosk lock turned off until turned back on
alert.offByCode: Kiosk lock lifted with the owner code (15 minutes)
alert.onExpired: Kiosk lock came back on by itself
alert.exitAttempt: Someone tried to close the POS app
alert.codeBlocked: 5 wrong owner codes: the owner-code unlock is closed for 15 minutes

kiosk.ownerIn: Kiosk lock off · the owner is signed in

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every action: who, when, from which device, and what changed
audit.exported: Exported, and recorded in the audit log
audit.verifiedOk: Chain intact: {count} entries checked, none altered
audit.verifiedBad: The chain is broken. Tell the owner and the IT support at once.
audit.noChanges: No field values recorded for this entry.
audit.readOnly: Read only: no entry can be edited or deleted, and each entry is linked to the one before it.
audit.select: Select an entry to see what changed.

auth.owner_two_step_reset: Owner 2-step code reset on the server PC
auth.password_accepted: Password accepted; waiting for the 2-step code
auth.password_recovered: Password recovered with the phone code and a recovery code
auth.owner_password_reset: Owner password reset on the server PC

device_trust.insert: PC trusted: no phone code there for a while

print.title: Print designer
print.subtitle: How invoices, quotations, credit notes and receipts look. Fields the tax law requires are locked. Owner only.

testThermal.browser: Test printing on the receipt printer works in the Windows app only.
testThermal.no_printer: Choose the receipt printer first in Settings → Devices and printers.
testThermal.failed: The receipt printer did not print. Check that it is on and connected.
testThermal.no_drawer: The cash drawer opens only with a thermal receipt printer (ESC/POS).

print.noLogo: No logo yet: add one in Settings → Company.
print.colorHint: For titles, the table header and the total (A4).

locked.title: Document title and type
locked.customerFull: Customer name, address and TRN (full tax invoice)
locked.lines: Lines: description, quantity, unit price, amount
locked.vat: VAT per line and in total

print.customerAddressLocked: Always printed on a full tax invoice.
print.discountLocked: Always printed when the document has a discount.
print.noBank: No bank account yet: add one in Settings → Company.
print.quotationTerms: A quotation's own terms, when it has them, replace these.
print.versionsNote: Every save is a new version, written to the audit log. Documents already issued print with the version they were issued with.

receiptLogo.title: Receipt logo
receiptLogo.alt: The logo printed on the thermal receipt
receiptLogo.own: The receipt prints its own logo.
receiptLogo.company: The receipt prints the company logo (Settings → Company).
receiptLogo.removed: The receipt prints the company logo again.
receiptLogo.hint: PNG or JPEG up to 512 KB. The thermal printer prints in black and white: a simple, high-contrast logo prints best. A4 documents keep the company logo.

dashboard.title: Owner dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Sales, profit and cash
dashboard.vatNote: VAT due = VAT on sales after returns. VAT on purchases is taken off once purchases are recorded in the program. Profit = sales without VAT minus the cost of goods stored with each sale.
dashboard.noCustomers: No named customers in this period (the cash customer is not counted).
dashboard.noReorder: No item is under its reorder level.
dashboard.noAccess: This screen is for the owner only.

backup.title: System health and backups
backup.subtitle: Three copies, on two kinds of media, one outside the shop
backup.restoreHelp: The newest copy is restored into a separate test database, then the audit log, the books, the stock and the numbering are checked. The real data is never touched. It takes a few minutes; the result appears below.

asked.backup_now: The backup has started; it appears below in a minute.
asked.offsite_now: The upload to Google Drive has started.
asked.restore_test: The restore test has started; the result appears below.
asked.offline_copy: The copy to the external drive has started.

problem.local_stale: The local backup is late: the backup service may be stopped.
problem.offsite_not_set_up: The off-site copy is not set up yet: create the backup key and connect Google Drive.
problem.offsite_stale: The off-site copy is late: check the internet and Google Drive.
problem.offsite_failed: The last upload to Google Drive failed.
problem.offline_due: Time for the weekly copy to the external drive.
problem.integrity_issues: The integrity checks found a problem: see below.
problem.disk_low: The backup disk is nearly full.

backup.keySet: Set: the off-site copies are encrypted with it.
backup.notEncrypted: not encrypted: keep the drive locked away
backup.automatic: The backup service makes a local copy every hour, an encrypted off-site copy every day and checks the data every night, by itself.
backup.keySaved: The backup key is set. Keep the printed key safe.
backup.keyLast6Wrong: These are not the last 6 characters of the key.
backup.keyExplain: The backup key has two parts. The public part stays on the server and encrypts the off-site copies. The private part is shown once now: print it or save it on a USB stick, and keep it somewhere safe. Without it, the copies on Google Drive can never be opened, not even by us.
backup.keyReplaceWarn: A new key encrypts the next copies only. Keep the old key too: it is the only way to open the older copies.
backup.keyOnce: Shown once only. Print it or save it now.
backup.keyWhere: Keep the paper and the USB stick in a safe place, away from this PC.
backup.keyLast6: Type the last 6 characters of the key
backup.driveRunbook: The app can only see and change the files it uploads itself.
backup.driveStep: Open {url} on your phone or a PC, sign in with the backup account, and type this code:
backup.keySheetTitle: ARTEPOOL ERP — مفتاح النسخ الاحتياطي / backup key
backup.chooseExplain: The browser opens Google's page: choose the shop's Google account (the one for backups) and press Allow. Then come back here.
backup.inBrowser: Finish in the browser: choose the account and press Allow. This window closes by itself.
backup.codeExplain: You will see a short code. Type it at google.com/device on any phone or PC, signed in with the shop's Google account.
backup.googleCancelled: Google sign-in did not finish. Try again.
backup.googleMissing: This installation has no Google registration yet. The installer adds it; ask the person who installed the system.
